name: humble-task-force
description: Humble Task Force — product-owner↔manager↔developer pipeline with two review gates: /draft-brief (Product Owner frames a feature's intent), /read-brief (Manager absorbs it + plans the build), /draft-ticket (draft against the brief), /review-ticket (Gate 1: Product Owner signs off the plan), /start-ticket (walkthrough + Q&A training, then plan, then build), /handoff (report from the real diff), /manager-review (Gate 2: check the PR against acceptance criteria, with a blocking crash gate for errors that terminate the app instead of surfacing to a handler), plus a bug loop — /report-bug (tester files a clean, labelled bug issue with screenshot) and /fetch-bug (developer validates it against the code and fixes it) — /run-desktop (launch the desktop app for review, no questions asked), and /draft-prd, /draft-architecture, /setup-tickets, and the kmp-arch-v2 skill (KMP architecture guide: native UI on Android/iOS/Desktop + maximal shared Kotlin, SKIE bridging, money/i18n/testing conventions) available to every installed Claude as /humble-task-force:kmp-arch-v2.
